name: run-gauntlet
title_zh: 让多个智能体在关卡式流程中互相审查并交付
tagline_zh: 面对复杂任务，单个智能体容易自嗨出错。这个技能把任务拆成关卡，让不同智能体独立取证、互相挑错，最后干净验收。
tagline_en: One agent alone tends to fool itself. This skill turns tasks into checkpoints where agents gather evidence.
desc_en: Execute an existing agent-ready Gauntlet Pack through bounded builder-critic loops, independent evidence collection, formal state transitions, and clean-room final verification. Use when `.gauntlet/manifest.yaml` or an equivalent compiled pack exists and the user wants agents to implement, adapt, repair, or validate the target. Do not use to invent requirements from a vague request; invoke compile
why_zh: 它用形式化状态机管住整个流程，builder 和 critic 被硬性隔离，证据收集独立于结论。
why_en: Formal state transitions keep builder and critic strictly separated, evidence is gathered independently of conclusions, and a.
limit_zh: 必须已有 .gauntlet/manifest.yaml 或等价编译包；它不会从模糊需求里发明任务。只覆盖实现、适配。
limit_en: Requires an existing .gauntlet/manifest.yaml or compiled pack; won't invent tasks from vague asks. Only covers implement, adapt, repair.
